ops.title: Embedding lookup and carrier replication
ops.note: Token lookup and copying are memory work. Four carrier streams are NOT four attention copies. No positional embedding GEMM.

ops.title: Attention iHC gate projection
ops.note: Flatten the four carrier vectors and project to four pre gates plus four post gates. FP32 projection weights in our source.

ops.title: Carrier inverse RMS and gate nonlinearities
ops.note: Inverse RMS: 2(4H)+2. Eight projection rescalings; four pre gates use 6 ops each and four post gates use 7. Post magnitude is 2; gate epsilon is added.

ops.title: Weighted four-stream reduction
ops.note: Four multiplications and three additions per hidden coordinate. Attention/FFN consume only the reduced 6,144-wide vector.

ops.title: Attention input RMSNorm
ops.note: RMSNorm follows carrier reduction. A fused iHC kernel may include it; it is counted once.

ops.title: Attention iHC writeback / GLM residual add
ops.note: For each stream: new carrier = old carrier + post gate times branch output. This replaces, not supplements, the GLM residual add.

ops.title: FFN iHC gate projection
ops.note: Flatten the four carrier vectors and project to four pre gates plus four post gates. FP32 projection weights in our source.

ops.title: Carrier inverse RMS and gate nonlinearities
ops.note: Inverse RMS: 2(4H)+2. Eight projection rescalings; four pre gates use 6 ops each and four post gates use 7. Post magnitude is 2; gate epsilon is added.

ops.title: Weighted four-stream reduction
ops.note: Four multiplications and three additions per hidden coordinate. Attention/FFN consume only the reduced 6,144-wide vector.

ops.title: FFN input RMSNorm
ops.note: RMSNorm follows carrier reduction. A fused iHC kernel may include it; it is counted once.

ops.title: FFN iHC writeback / GLM residual add
ops.note: For each stream: new carrier = old carrier + post gate times branch output. This replaces, not supplements, the GLM residual add.

ops.title: Fused query-A and KV-A projection
ops.note: Split into query latent 2,048, KV latent 512, and shared RoPE key 64. This is one packed projection, not three independent copies.

ops.title: Query / KV latent RMSNorm
ops.note: Both latent vectors are normalized before their downstream projections.

ops.title: Query-B expansion
ops.note: Each head gets a 192-dimensional non-RoPE query and a 64-dimensional RoPE query.

ops.title: Absorb key-up weights into query
ops.note: Per-head BMM with the key slice of KV-B weights. No full 64-head key tensor is expanded for every cached token.

ops.title: Query and shared-key RoPE
ops.note: Three arithmetic operations per rotated scalar. Position-frequency constants differ; the counted rotation width is the same.

ops.title: Store this layer's compressed KV
ops.formula: 0 arithmetic FLOPs; 576 logical KV coordinates per token / layer
ops.note: Normalized compressed latent plus rotated key coordinates. Cache writes, layout conversion and quantization traffic are not counted here. The 4-stream residual carrier does not change these KV dimensions.

ops.title: Indexer query projection
ops.note: Only on a full indexer layer. A shared-index layer does not recompute these tensors.

ops.title: Indexer key projection
ops.note: Only on a full indexer layer. A shared-index layer does not recompute these tensors.

ops.title: Indexer head-weight projection
ops.note: Only on a full indexer layer. A shared-index layer does not recompute these tensors.

ops.title: Indexer key LayerNorm
ops.flow: 32 query heads + one shared key; width 128
ops.note: Hadamard has seven butterfly stages plus normalization. RoPE width is 64, not the full index-head width.

ops.title: Indexer query / key RoPE
ops.flow: 32 query heads + one shared key; width 128
ops.note: Hadamard has seven butterfly stages plus normalization. RoPE width is 64, not the full index-head width.

ops.title: Indexer Hadamard and normalization
ops.flow: 32 query heads + one shared key; width 128
ops.note: Hadamard has seven butterfly stages plus normalization. RoPE width is 64, not the full index-head width.

ops.title: Indexer head-weight scaling
ops.flow: 32 query heads + one shared key; width 128
ops.note: Hadamard has seven butterfly stages plus normalization. RoPE width is 64, not the full index-head width.

ops.title: Causal candidate scoring
ops.flow: C causal pairs → one score per pair
ops.note: Dot products, ReLU, head weighting and reduction over 32 heads. ReLU comparisons are outside the FLOP ledger. Same 2h reduction convention as the GLM page.

ops.title: Top-2,048 selection and inter-layer ID reuse
ops.note: 21 layers refresh; 57 reuse the preceding full layer's token IDs. Reusing IDs does NOT reuse attention outputs or skip that layer's KV projection.

ops.title: Reuse the preceding full layer's selected IDs
ops.flow: Prior selected-position list → current layer's sparse attention
ops.note: This is the alternative to a full indexer refresh. Current-layer attention still reads current-layer KV and recomputes every head output.

ops.title: Sparse query-key dot products
ops.note: The absorbed QK dot width is 576, not the unabsorbed 256.

ops.title: Attention score scaling
ops.note: Scale each selected score before normalization.

ops.title: Selected softmax
ops.note: Subtract max, exp, denominator sum, divide. Maximum comparisons are not FLOPs.

ops.title: Sparse probability-value accumulation
ops.note: Accumulate the compressed 512-wide latent value, not the final 256-wide head output.

ops.title: Learnable sink in softmax denominator
ops.flow: 64 learned logits; one extra denominator term per query/head
ops.note: Add exp(sink minus row max) to the denominator; it has no key dot product and no value vector. This logical convention adds subtract, exp, add; comparisons excluded.

ops.title: Latent-value to head-value expansion
ops.note: Per-head BMM with the value slice of KV-B weights; the attention gate is applied AFTER this expansion.

ops.title: Elementwise attention-gate projection
ops.note: A separate learned 6,144 by 16,384 matrix in every layer, using the normalized attention input. Fallback projects earlier; HPC can defer and fuse the GEMM with gate application.

ops.title: Sigmoid gate times head outputs
ops.note: One sigmoid (exp, add, divide) plus one multiplication per head-output element. There is a distinct gate for each of the 16,384 coordinates.

ops.title: Attention output projection
ops.note: Return to hidden width before iHC writeback. Gate projection and output projection have the same logical GEMM cost, but opposite matrix dimensions.

ops.title: Dense gate/up projections
ops.note: HY4: only layer 0, intermediate width 18,432. GLM: layers 0-2, width 12,288.

ops.title: Dense down projection
ops.note: HY4: only layer 0, intermediate width 18,432. GLM: layers 0-2, width 12,288.

ops.title: Dense SiLU and multiply
ops.note: Three sigmoid operations plus gate multiplication plus up multiplication. No routed-expert clamp on the dense layer.

ops.title: MoE routing projection
ops.note: Score 256 routed experts; select eight. The shared expert is always active, not selected by this router.

ops.title: Routing sigmoid, bias, normalization and scale
ops.note: Top-8 comparisons and dispatch are separate. Fold the routed scale into eight normalized route weights in this logical ledger; actual backend may apply it later.

ops.title: Expert Top-8 and token dispatch
ops.flow: ℝT × 6,144 → 8T routed token-expert assignments + T shared rows
ops.formula: 0 arithmetic FLOPs; comparisons, permutations and communication
ops.note: Eight routed copies are a logical assignment count, not necessarily one materialized tensor. Routing, grouped-GEMM layout and any EP all-to-all can consume substantial time despite zero FLOPs in this row.

ops.title: Eight routed experts: gate/up
ops.note: Count active token-expert assignments, not all 256 stored experts. Real grouped GEMM padding and routing imbalance are not included.

ops.title: Eight routed experts: down
ops.note: Count active token-expert assignments, not all 256 stored experts. Real grouped GEMM padding and routing imbalance are not included.

ops.title: Eight routed experts: SiLU and multiply
ops.note: HY4 clamps ONLY routed expert gate/up inputs to limit 10. Shared-expert fusion is disabled because the shared branch must remain unclamped. Clamp comparisons are outside FLOPs.

ops.title: One shared expert: gate/up
ops.note: Count active token-expert assignments, not all 256 stored experts. Real grouped GEMM padding and routing imbalance are not included.

ops.title: One shared expert: down
ops.note: Count active token-expert assignments, not all 256 stored experts. Real grouped GEMM padding and routing imbalance are not included.

ops.title: One shared expert: SiLU and multiply
ops.note: HY4 clamps ONLY routed expert gate/up inputs to limit 10. Shared-expert fusion is disabled because the shared branch must remain unclamped. Clamp comparisons are outside FLOPs.

ops.title: Weighted routed reduction plus shared output
ops.flow: 8 weighted outputs + 1 unweighted shared output → ℝT × 6,144
ops.note: Eight route multiplications, seven routed-sum additions, one shared addition. Unlike the old GLM ledger, omit the identity multiplication by the shared expert's unit weight.

ops.title: Final iHC head reduction
ops.note: Final 24,576 to 4 gate projection, inverse RMS, sigmoid gates, weighted reduction. Runs on all prompt rows before logits selection, not just the final row.

ops.title: Final RMSNorm
ops.note: All prompt rows in the source forward. Fusion does not duplicate the arithmetic.

ops.title: Last-token LM head
ops.note: One requested next-token logits row, no prompt logprobs. HY4 vocab 120,832 versus GLM 154,880. MTP/draft and subsequent decode steps excluded.
